descriptions.text: Attacks can come from all angles. Straight to number 6 on our leaderboard for bZx, who lost $55M to a phishing attack.

The margin trading lending platform bZx tweeted that the private keys controlling Polygon and Binance Smart Chain (BSC) deployment appeared to have been leaked, resulting in a loss of funds. The bZx smart contract itself was not compromised, and the deployment, governance and DAO vault of Ethereum were not affected by this incident.

On November 5, 2021, bZx (later Ooki Protocol) suffered a $55 million loss when an attacker compromised a developer's private key, allowing manipulation of deployment wallets and draining funds across Binance Smart Chain and Polygon. Ethereum deployments remained safe due to DAO custody. A developer's private key controlling privileged admin functions on BSC and Polygon deployments was compromised, likely via phishing. The attacker exploited the single-key design, invoked ownership transfer, and drained approved tokens. Ethereum was not affected because it used DAO-based multi-party custody.
